identity.title: [v0.92][Runtime] Wire ACC-governed tool execution into resident-agent cycles

values.summary: Wired typed resident tool authority and actual long-lived Runtime provider outputs through UTS-to-ACC compilation, Freedom Gate evaluation, injected governed adapter dispatch, and lineage-bound terminal receipts.
actual_changes: Added typed resident authority id/ref/digest and sorted allowlist validation.
Added a Runtime-owned resident proposal service using the real UTS-to-ACC compiler and Freedom Gate.
Refactored governed execution to accept an injected adapter while keeping fixture dispatch test-only.
Integrated provider StepOutput processing into long-lived Runtime cycles and fail-closed denial receipts.
